description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple datasets/metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels rotated diagonally; the axis label is “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Score (%)” ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows a pair of side-by-side bars corresponding to the legend “Model”: LLaMA-3-8B-it in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in brown. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~79 (blue) and ~80 (brown); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (brown); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (brown); TruthfulQA ~44 (blue) and ~60 (brown); ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (brown); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (brown); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (brown); MT-Bench (×5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (brown); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (brown). The bars are grouped by benchmark (two bars per group) with no stacking, no visible error bars or annotations, and the categories appear in the listed order rather than being sorted by value; no bars are visually emphasized beyond the consistent color coding.
